groups.title: Nuxt Data Fetching Composables
groups.question: Your Nuxt page fetches products during server rendering, then fetches them again in the browser. Explain how useFetch and useAsyncData avoid this.

followUps.useFetch vs useAsyncData: When to Use Ea: When would you use useFetch and when useAsyncData?
followUps.Keys and Cache Deduplication: What does the key in useAsyncData do?

evidence.text: useFetch is a shortcut for fetching a URL.
useAsyncData wraps any async function for more complex cases.
Both carry server results to the client so the request is not repeated.
The key identifies the data in Nuxt's cache.
Calls with the same key share the result.
Reusing a key for different data shows the wrong data.

groups.title: Rendering Strategies
groups.question: Users see a spinner on every page while slow data loads, even though the server already rendered it. Explain the payload and lazy fetching.

followUps.Universal Rendering and Payload Transfer: How does the SSR payload stop the client from refetching?
followUps.Lazy Fetching and Suspense: What does the lazy option change?

evidence.text: Server fetch results are stored as JSON in the HTML.
The client reads them during hydration instead of fetching again.
Large payloads make the page heavier, so only needed data should be fetched.

notEnough: Only saying data is passed to the client.

evidence.text: Lazy fetching does not block rendering the page.
The page renders first with a pending state.
The template must handle that loading state, for example with a skeleton.

groups.title: TypeScript in Nuxt Components
groups.question: You want full type safety from your server API to your components' props in Nuxt. Explain how you would type props and use Nuxt's generated types.

followUps.defineProps with TypeScript Generics: How do you type props with defineProps?
followUps.Auto-generated Types from Nuxt: What types does Nuxt generate for you?

evidence.text: An interface describes the props.
It is passed as a type parameter to defineProps.
Props are then typed in the script and template.
Nuxt generates types for routes, server endpoints and runtime config.
Calling your own API with useFetch gets typed responses.
Regenerating keeps the types in sync with the code.

groups.title: Server Routes and API Handlers
groups.question: You are adding API endpoints to your Nuxt app for listing and creating orders. Explain server routes and how they read requests.

followUps.server/api/ Route Conventions: How do server/api files become endpoints?
followUps.Event Handling with H3: How do H3 helpers read the request?

evidence.text: Files in server/api become API routes.
File names like index.get.ts or index.post.ts handle specific methods.
This code only runs on the server.

notEnough: Only saying server routes make APIs.

evidence.text: Handlers receive an event object for the request.
Helpers like readBody, getQuery and setCookie work with it.
Input from the request must still be validated.
